rejected_alternatives.why: it destroys the primary criteria: with the block gone, an answer that does NOT contain the needle is the expected outcome, so T1 (needle in every answer) and T2 (byte-identical answers) would measure nothing. Written down so nobody proposes it again.

criteria_ruling.source: M3-PREREG.md §11 (revised after the 3-round smoke; all three 改对象)
criteria_ruling.C2: same as S3_cells (comparison inside the same phase, before the ask)
criteria_ruling.I1: empty answer / needle missing / pos_asked != raw_pos_max_before_ask + 1; ask rc is recorded and NOT judged

criterion_conflicts.cause: kvshim_ask_at appends the question and the generated answer to the SAME sequence, so after the ask LIVE owns its own dialogue cells; the residual is exactly those tokens, not block cells. The declared formula compares post-detach to at-attach across the ask, so it cannot hold by construction.

two structural causes, both measured: (1) raw_pos_max is ABSOLUTE, so 4095 - 4146 = -51 is a position span, not a cell count; the block's top (4095) minus an empty sequence (-1) is 4096, not 91. (2) the post-detach reading also includes the round's own tokens.
criterion_conflicts.proposal: S3 (position side) := pos_max_at_attach == attach_pos_hi - 1; the 91-cell claim moves to the cell side: cells_at_attach - cells_before_attach == 91 (that form HOLDS here: True).

judgement.formula: 通过 := 50 个有效轮 + S1..S3 + T1..T2 + C1..C5 + L1..L4 全部成立；若有无效轮 => 本轮作废重跑（无效轮不算通过也不算未通过）；若 S/C 任何一条不成立 => 未通过（上升/不回收）；若 T 不成立 => 未通过（丢了记忆）。
